opened_sources.finding: Opened Reuters report documents a student-led anti-government rally, clashes with police, and demand for early elections. Crowd estimates differ: police 34,300; Archive of Public Gatherings about 100,000.
opened_sources.excerpt: Police fired tear gas and clashed with protesters in central Belgrade on Saturday

opened_sources.finding: Opened report documents thousands rallying in Kraljevo on June 28 and a pro-government rally in Belgrade the preceding day. The Belgrade rally is not opposition protest; include only if the inventory tracks all public political demonstrations, otherwise review classification.
opened_sources.excerpt: Thousands of protesters have packed the streets of the central Serbian city of Kraljevo
